Verified: 96 fragments from a 4x4 cube, real seed-determinism, real local shotgun-blast-opens-a-hole scenario (4/96 fragments detached). bazel test //... 3/3 pass. docs/NORTHSTAR_PAPER_ENGINE.md has the full design + a long list of flagged future mechanics (wet-concrete transfer, worker rebuild events, fractal/math-heavy simulation).
